import json
import re
import sys

preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
preparationStatusCode = "500"
preparationMessage = "Workflow input preparation did not complete."
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedOrganizationName = ""
escapedTargetName = ""
waitRequested = ""
waitTimeoutSeconds = 0
ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$")

try:
    organization = sys.argv[1]
    targetName = sys.argv[2]
    waitText = sys.argv[3].strip().lower()
    timeoutText = sys.argv[4].strip()
    errors = []

    if not ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(organization):
        errors.append("Device Organization must match the current organization.Organization Name schema: 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
    if not targetName or targetName != targetName.strip():
        errors.append("Target Name must be nonblank and must not contain leading or trailing whitespace.")
    elif len(targetName) > 255:
        errors.append("Target Name must not exceed 255 characters.")
    elif any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in targetName):
        errors.append("Target Name must not contain control characters.")

    if waitText in ("true", "1"):
        waitRequested = "true"
    elif waitText in ("false", "0"):
        waitRequested = "false"
    else:
        waitRequested = "invalid"
        errors.append("Wait for Completion must be a boolean value.")

    try:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = int(timeoutText)
    except Exception:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = -1
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must be an integer.")
    if waitRequested == "true" and not (1 <= waitTimeoutSeconds <= 600):
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds is required when waiting and must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
    if waitRequested == "false" and waitTimeoutSeconds < 0:
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must not be negative.")

    if errors:
        preparationStatus = "invalid"
        preparationStatusCode = "400"
        preparationMessage = " ".join(errors)
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Input validation failed", "details": errors}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        escapedOrganizationName = organization.replace("'", "''")
        escapedTargetName = targetName.replace("'", "''")
        preparationStatus = "ready"
        preparationStatusCode = "200"
        preparationMessage = "Organization, exact target name, OData values, and bounded-wait inputs are valid."
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"validated": True, "waitForCompletion": waitRequested == "true", "waitTimeoutSeconds": waitTimeoutSeconds if waitRequested == "true" else None, "supportedTargetTypes": ["UCSD"]}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
    preparationStatusCode = "500"
    preparationMessage = str(exc)
    preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Workflow input preparation failed", "detail": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

import json
import re
import sys

organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
organizationStatusCode = "500"
organizationMessage = "Organization inspection did not complete."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
organizationMoid = ""
MOID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$")

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or not isinstance(payload.get("Results"), list):
        raise ValueError("Organization response must contain a Results array.")
    results = payload["Results"]
    count = payload.get("Count")
    if isinstance(count, bool) or not isinstance(count, int) or count < 0:
        raise ValueError("Organization response Count must be a nonnegative integer.")
    if count > 2:
        organizationStatus = "conflict"
        organizationStatusCode = "409"
        organizationMessage = "The exact organization lookup returned more than one resource."
        organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage, "matchCount": count, "resultPageCount": len(results)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif count != len(results):
        raise ValueError("Organization response Count does not equal the bounded Results page length.")
    elif count == 0:
        organizationStatus = "not-found"
        organizationStatusCode = "404"
        organizationMessage = "No organization matched Device Organization exactly."
        organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage, "organizationName": expectedName}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif count != 1:
        organizationStatus = "conflict"
        organizationStatusCode = "409"
        organizationMessage = "The exact organization lookup returned more than one resource."
        organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage, "matchCount": count}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("Name") != expectedName:
            raise ValueError("The returned organization does not preserve the exact requested Name.")
        if item.get("ClassId") != "organization.Organization" or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization":
            raise ValueError("The returned resource is not a concrete organization.Organization.")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not MOID_PATTERN.fullmatch(moid):
            raise ValueError("The returned organization Moid is missing or malformed.")
        organizationMoid = moid
        organizationStatus = "ready"
        organizationStatusCode = "200"
        organizationMessage = "Exactly one concrete organization was resolved."
        organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": expectedName, "ObjectType": "organization.Organization"}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    organizationStatus = "invalid-resource" if organizationStatus == "helper-failure" else organizationStatus
    organizationStatusCode = "502" if organizationStatus == "invalid-resource" else organizationStatusCode
    organizationMessage = str(exc)
    organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Organization response validation failed", "detail": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

import json
import re
import sys

targetStatus = "helper-failure"
targetStatusCode = "500"
targetMessage = "Target inspection did not complete."
targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": targetMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
targetMoid = ""
registeredDeviceMoid = ""
resolvedTargetType = ""
registeredPlatformType = ""
resolvedTargetStatus = ""
resolvedConnectionStatus = ""
MOID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$")

def valid_relationship(value, expected_moid, expected_type):
    return (isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("Moid") == expected_moid and
            value.get("ObjectType") == expected_type and
            value.get("ClassId") in ("mo.MoRef", expected_type))

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
    if not MOID_PATTERN.fullmatch(organizationMoid):
        raise ValueError("The resolved organization Moid is malformed.")
    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or not isinstance(payload.get("Results"), list):
        raise ValueError("Target response must contain a Results array.")
    results = payload["Results"]
    count = payload.get("Count")
    if isinstance(count, bool) or not isinstance(count, int) or count < 0:
        raise ValueError("Target response Count must be a nonnegative integer.")
    if count > 2:
        targetStatus = "conflict"
        targetStatusCode = "409"
        targetMessage = "The exact organization-scoped target lookup returned more than one resource."
        targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": targetMessage, "matchCount": count, "resultPageCount": len(results)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif count != len(results):
        raise ValueError("Target response Count does not equal the bounded Results page length.")
    elif count == 0:
        targetStatus = "not-found"
        targetStatusCode = "404"
        targetMessage = "No asset.Target matched Target Name exactly in Device Organization."
        targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": targetMessage, "targetName": expectedName}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif count != 1:
        targetStatus = "conflict"
        targetStatusCode = "409"
        targetMessage = "The exact organization-scoped target lookup returned more than one resource."
        targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": targetMessage, "matchCount": count}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("Name") != expectedName:
            raise ValueError("The target response does not preserve the exact requested Name.")
        if item.get("ClassId") != "asset.Target" or item.get("ObjectType") != "asset.Target":
            raise ValueError("The returned resource is not a concrete asset.Target.")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not MOID_PATTERN.fullmatch(moid):
            raise ValueError("The target Moid is missing or malformed.")
        permissions = item.get("PermissionResources")
        if not isinstance(permissions, list):
            raise ValueError("The target PermissionResources relationship array is missing.")
        matches = [rel for rel in permissions if isinstance(rel, dict) and rel.get("Moid") == organizationMoid]
        if len(matches) != 1 or not valid_relationship(matches[0], organizationMoid, "organization.Organization"):
            raise ValueError("The target must contain exactly one validated relationship to the resolved organization.")
        targetType = item.get("TargetType")
        if not isinstance(targetType, str) or not targetType:
            targetStatus = "unsupported"
            targetStatusCode = "422"
            targetMessage = "TargetType is missing; target support cannot be established safely."
            targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": targetMessage, "supportedTargetTypes": ["UCSD"]}, separators=(",", ":"))
        elif targetType != "UCSD":
            targetStatus = "unsupported"
            targetStatusCode = "422"
            targetMessage = "This export supports only TargetType UCSD under the current recovery schema evidence."
            targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": targetMessage, "targetType": targetType, "supportedTargetTypes": ["UCSD"]}, separators=(",", ":"))
        elif item.get("Status") != "Connected":
            targetStatus = "unavailable"
            targetStatusCode = "409"
            targetMessage = "The UCSD target must have Status Connected before a backup can be requested."
            targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": targetMessage, "targetStatus": item.get("Status")}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            registration = item.get("RegisteredDevice")
            if not isinstance(registration, dict):
                raise ValueError("RegisteredDevice was not expanded to a concrete asset.DeviceRegistration.")
            regMoid = registration.get("Moid")
            if not isinstance(regMoid, str) or not MOID_PATTERN.fullmatch(regMoid):
                raise ValueError("RegisteredDevice Moid is missing or malformed.")
            if registration.get("ClassId") != "asset.DeviceRegistration" or registration.get("ObjectType") != "asset.DeviceRegistration":
                raise ValueError("RegisteredDevice is not a concrete asset.DeviceRegistration.")
            if registration.get("PlatformType") != "UCSD":
                targetStatus = "unsupported"
                targetStatusCode = "422"
                targetMessage = "RegisteredDevice PlatformType must be UCSD and agree with TargetType."
                targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": targetMessage, "platformType": registration.get("PlatformType"), "supportedPlatformTypes": ["UCSD"]}, separators=(",", ":"))
            else:
                connection = registration.get("ConnectionStatus")
                if connection not in (None, "", "Connected"):
                    targetStatus = "unavailable"
                    targetStatusCode = "409"
                    targetMessage = "RegisteredDevice ConnectionStatus must be Connected when the service reports it."
                    targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": targetMessage, "connectionStatus": connection}, separators=(",", ":"))
                else:
                    targetMoid = moid
                    registeredDeviceMoid = regMoid
                    resolvedTargetType = targetType
                    registeredPlatformType = registration["PlatformType"]
                    resolvedTargetStatus = item["Status"]
                    resolvedConnectionStatus = connection or "not-reported"
                    targetStatus = "ready"
                    targetStatusCode = "200"
                    targetMessage = "Exactly one connected UCSD target and concrete registered device were validated."
                    targetResultJson = json.dumps({"target":{"Moid":moid,"Name":expectedName,"TargetType":targetType,"Status":item["Status"]},"registeredDevice":{"Moid":regMoid,"PlatformType":registration["PlatformType"],"ConnectionStatus":resolvedConnectionStatus},"organizationMoid":organizationMoid}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    if targetStatus == "helper-failure":
        targetStatus = "invalid-resource"
        targetStatusCode = "502"
    targetMessage = str(exc)
    targetResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Target response validation failed", "detail": targetMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

bodyStatus = "helper-failure"
bodyStatusCode = "500"
bodyMessage = "Backup request body construction did not complete."
bodyResultJson = json.dumps({"error": bodyMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
requestBody = ""
MOID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$")

try:
    organizationMoid, targetMoid, registeredDeviceMoid, targetType, platformType, targetStatus = sys.argv[1:7]
    if not all(MOID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) for value in (organizationMoid, targetMoid, registeredDeviceMoid)):
        raise ValueError("A resolved organization, target, or registered-device Moid is malformed.")
    if targetType != "UCSD" or platformType != "UCSD" or targetStatus != "Connected":
        raise ValueError("The target summary is no longer consistent with the supported connected UCSD route.")
    body = {
        "ClassId": "recovery.OnDemandBackup",
        "ObjectType": "recovery.OnDemandBackup",
        "DeviceId": {"ClassId": "mo.MoRef", "ObjectType": "asset.DeviceRegistration", "Moid": registeredDeviceMoid},
        "Organization": {"ClassId": "mo.MoRef", "ObjectType": "organization.Organization", "Moid": organizationMoid}
    }
    if set(body) != {"ClassId", "ObjectType", "DeviceId", "Organization"}:
        raise ValueError("The backup request body contains an unexpected top-level field.")
    requestBody = json.dumps(body, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
    bodyStatus = "ready"
    bodyStatusCode = "200"
    bodyMessage = "The exact recovery.OnDemandBackup request body is valid."
    bodyResultJson = json.dumps({"validated": True, "targetMoid": targetMoid, "registeredDeviceMoid": registeredDeviceMoid, "organizationMoid": organizationMoid, "topLevelFields": sorted(body)}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    bodyStatus = "helper-failure"
    bodyStatusCode = "500"
    bodyMessage = str(exc)
    bodyResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Backup request body construction failed", "detail": bodyMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Starts the 1-600 second wait only after safe POST acceptance and derives one initial plus four inter-poll delays below the 180-second helper bound.
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

pollingStatus = "helper-failure"
pollingStatusCode = "500"
pollingMessage = "Polling deadline initialization did not complete."
pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"error": pollingMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
deadlineEpoch = ""
initialDelaySeconds = ""
pollIntervalSeconds = ""
try:
    timeout = int(sys.argv[1])
    if timeout < 1 or timeout > 600:
        raise ValueError("The normalized wait timeout must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
    now = time.time()
    initialDelay = min(2.0, max(0.25, timeout / 20.0))
    interval = max(1.0, max(0.0, timeout - initialDelay) / 4.0)
    if initialDelay > 2.0 or interval >= 180.0:
        raise ValueError("The derived polling delays exceed safe helper action bounds.")
    deadlineEpoch = "%.6f" % (now + timeout)
    initialDelaySeconds = "%.6f" % initialDelay
    pollIntervalSeconds = "%.6f" % interval
    pollingStatus = "ready"
    pollingStatusCode = "200"
    pollingMessage = "A finite polling deadline and safe five-attempt schedule were initialized."
    pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"waitTimeoutSeconds":timeout,"initialDelaySeconds":initialDelay,"pollIntervalSeconds":interval,"maximumPollAttempts":5}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    pollingStatus = "helper-failure"
    pollingStatusCode = "500"
    pollingMessage = str(exc)
    pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Polling initialization failed","detail":pollingMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time
waitStatus = "helper-failure"
waitStatusCode = "500"
waitMessage = "Polling delay did not complete."
waitResultJson = json.dumps({"error": waitMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
try:
    deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
    initialDelay = float(sys.argv[2])
    pollInterval = float(sys.argv[3])
    attempt = int(sys.argv[4])
    requestedDelay = initialDelay if attempt == 0 else pollInterval
    stage = "backup completion poll " + str(attempt + 1)
    if requestedDelay < 0 or requestedDelay >= 180:
        raise ValueError("The requested polling delay is outside the safe helper bound.")
    remaining = deadline - time.time()
    if remaining <= 0:
        waitStatus = "timeout"
        waitStatusCode = "408"
        waitMessage = "The backup wait deadline was reached before " + stage + "."
        waitResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted":True,"completionVerified":False,"timeout":True,"stage":stage}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        actualDelay = min(requestedDelay, remaining)
        time.sleep(actualDelay)
        waitStatus = "ready"
        waitStatusCode = "200"
        waitMessage = "The bounded delay before " + stage + " completed."
        waitResultJson = json.dumps({"stage":stage,"requestedDelaySeconds":requestedDelay,"actualDelaySeconds":actualDelay}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    waitStatus = "helper-failure"
    waitStatusCode = "500"
    waitMessage = str(exc)
    waitResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Polling delay helper failed","detail":waitMessage,"requestAccepted":True}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
import time

completionStatus = "helper-failure"
completionStatusCode = "500"
completionMessage = "Backup completion inspection did not complete."
completionResultJson = json.dumps({"error": completionMessage, "requestAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))
MOID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$")

def validate_ref(value, expected_moid, expected_type, label):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("Moid") != expected_moid:
        raise ValueError(label + " relationship does not preserve the expected Moid.")
    if value.get("ObjectType") != expected_type or value.get("ClassId") not in ("mo.MoRef", expected_type):
        raise ValueError(label + " relationship discriminators are invalid.")

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    backupMoid, deviceMoid, organizationMoid = sys.argv[2:5]
    deadline = float(sys.argv[5])
    attempt = int(sys.argv[6])
    if attempt < 1 or attempt > 5:
        raise ValueError("Poll attempt must be between 1 and 5.")
    if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("Moid") != backupMoid:
        raise ValueError("Polled backup identity does not preserve the created Moid.")
    if item.get("ClassId") != "recovery.OnDemandBackup" or item.get("ObjectType") != "recovery.OnDemandBackup":
        raise ValueError("Polled resource is not a concrete recovery.OnDemandBackup.")
    validate_ref(item.get("DeviceId"), deviceMoid, "asset.DeviceRegistration", "DeviceId")
    validate_ref(item.get("Organization"), organizationMoid, "organization.Organization", "Organization")
    state = "not-reported"
    stage = ""
    entriesSummary = []
    config = item.get("ConfigResult")
    if config not in (None, {}):
        if not isinstance(config, dict) or config.get("ClassId") != "recovery.ConfigResult" or config.get("ObjectType") != "recovery.ConfigResult":
            raise ValueError("ConfigResult must be expanded as a concrete recovery.ConfigResult.")
        configMoid = config.get("Moid")
        if not isinstance(configMoid, str) or not MOID_PATTERN.fullmatch(configMoid):
            raise ValueError("Expanded ConfigResult Moid is missing or malformed.")
        state = config.get("ConfigState")
        stage = config.get("ConfigStage")
        if state is None:
            state = ""
        elif not isinstance(state, str):
            raise ValueError("ConfigResult.ConfigState must be a string when present.")
        if stage is None:
            stage = ""
        elif not isinstance(stage, str):
            raise ValueError("ConfigResult.ConfigStage must be a string when present.")
        entries = config.get("ResultEntries")
        if entries is None:
            entries = []
        if not isinstance(entries, list):
            raise ValueError("ConfigResult.ResultEntries must be an array or null.")
        entryMoids = set()
        for entry in entries:
            if not isinstance(entry, dict) or entry.get("ClassId") != "recovery.ConfigResultEntry" or entry.get("ObjectType") != "recovery.ConfigResultEntry":
                raise ValueError("Every ResultEntries item must be an expanded recovery.ConfigResultEntry.")
            entryMoid = entry.get("Moid")
            if not isinstance(entryMoid, str) or not MOID_PATTERN.fullmatch(entryMoid) or entryMoid in entryMoids:
                raise ValueError("Every ResultEntries item must have a unique safe Moid.")
            entryMoids.add(entryMoid)
            entryState = entry.get("State")
            message = entry.get("Message")
            if entryState is not None and not isinstance(entryState, str):
                raise ValueError("ResultEntries.State must be a string when present.")
            if message is not None and not isinstance(message, str):
                raise ValueError("ResultEntries.Message must be a string when present.")
            entriesSummary.append({"Moid":entryMoid,"State":entryState,"Message":message})
        if state not in ("", "Ok", "Ok-with-warning", "Errored"):
            raise ValueError("ConfigResult.ConfigState is undocumented: " + state)
    result = {"requestAccepted":True,"completionVerified":False,"backupMoid":backupMoid,"attempt":attempt,"configState":state,"configStage":stage,"resultEntries":entriesSummary}
    if state == "Ok":
        completionStatus = "complete"
        completionStatusCode = "200"
        completionMessage = "Configuration backup completed with ConfigState Ok."
        result["completionVerified"] = True
    elif state == "Ok-with-warning":
        completionStatus = "warning"
        completionStatusCode = "200"
        completionMessage = "Configuration backup completed with ConfigState Ok-with-warning."
        result["completionVerified"] = True
        result["warning"] = True
    elif state == "Errored":
        completionStatus = "operation-failure"
        completionStatusCode = "500"
        completionMessage = "Configuration backup completed with ConfigState Errored."
    elif attempt >= 5 or time.time() >= deadline:
        completionStatus = "timeout"
        completionStatusCode = "408"
        completionMessage = "The bounded wait ended before a documented terminal ConfigState was observed."
        result["timeout"] = True
    else:
        completionStatus = "progress"
        completionStatusCode = "202"
        completionMessage = "The backup remains accepted without a documented terminal ConfigState."
    completionResultJson = json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    completionStatus = "invalid-resource" if completionStatus == "helper-failure" else completionStatus
    completionStatusCode = "502" if completionStatus == "invalid-resource" else completionStatusCode
    completionMessage = str(exc)
    completionResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Backup completion response validation failed","detail":completionMessage,"requestAccepted":True,"completionVerified":False}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Creates an on-demand backup for one connected, organization-scoped UCSD asset.Target and DeviceRegistration. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations, targets, registrations, backups/results and create recovery.OnDemandBackup. Identity, PermissionResources, RegisteredDevice, DeviceId, ConfigResult, connectivity, and type are validated. Current OpenAPI exposes only ucsd.BackupInfo, so v1 is UCSD-only pending tenant evidence. A preflight blocks nonterminal backups but permits historical Ok, Ok-with-warning, or Errored; lookup and POST can race. Wait=false means HTTP 2xx plus validated resource proves acceptance, not completion. Wait=true uses one 1-600 second deadline and at most five polls: Ok/Ok-with-warning succeed, Errored fails, and other states time out after validated stage/results. Generic APIs are used because no complete atomic exists.
